sentences.text: Perawat mendoakan Agus agar lekas sembuh setelah gigi bungsunya dicabut.
sentences.en: The nurse wished Agus a quick recovery after his wisdom tooth was pulled.
sentences.ko: 사랑니를 뽑은 아구스에게 간호사가 빨리 나으라고 인사했어요.

sentences.text: Wati ingin renovasi itu lekas selesai supaya bisa pindah sebelum Lebaran.
sentences.en: Wati wants the renovation to finish soon so she can move in before Eid.
sentences.ko: 와티는 르바란 전에 이사할 수 있게 공사가 빨리 끝나길 바라요.

sentences.text: Video kartun di ruang tunggu cukup seru sampai anak-anak lupa takut.
sentences.en: The cartoon in the waiting room is fun enough that the children forget to be scared.
sentences.ko: 대기실 만화가 재미있어서 아이들이 무서운 것도 잊어요.

sentences.text: Mencari barang antik di gudang belakang ternyata seru sekali.
sentences.en: Searching for antiques in the back shed turned out to be great fun.
sentences.ko: 뒤쪽 창고에서 골동품을 찾는 건 알고 보니 정말 재미있었어요.

sentences.text: Senyum Agus terlihat mempesona setelah giginya diputihkan.
sentences.en: Agus's smile looked dazzling after his teeth were whitened.
sentences.ko: 미백을 하고 나니 아구스의 미소가 눈부셨어요.

sentences.text: Lantai ubin motif lama di ruang tengah terlihat mempesona setelah dicuci.
sentences.en: The old patterned floor tiles in the main room looked stunning after being washed.
sentences.ko: 가운데 방의 옛 무늬 타일 바닥은 닦고 나니 눈부시게 예뻤어요.

sentences.text: Panggilan video dengan dokter sempat terputus karena sinyal lemah.
sentences.en: The video call with the doctor cut out because of a weak signal.
sentences.ko: 신호가 약해서 의사와의 영상 통화가 끊겼어요.

sentences.text: Aliran air ke rumah Wati terputus selama pipa diganti.
sentences.en: The water supply to Wati's house was cut off while the pipes were replaced.
sentences.ko: 배관을 바꾸는 동안 와티네 집 물이 끊겼어요.
